member.name: M:Tracto.Desktop.Input.Tests.ClipboardTests.CopyAsync_ContentionFailsThenSucceeds_ReturnsClipboardRef
member.summary: MockClipboardApiProvider.TryOpen fails 3 times then succeeds. CopyAsync must succeed and must not throw on the first failure.

member.name: M:Tracto.Desktop.Input.Tests.ClipboardTests.CopyAsync_FirstAttemptFails_DoesNotThrowOnFirstFailure
member.summary: First TryOpen call fails but subsequent ones succeed — engine must not throw on the very first failure; it must continue retrying.

member.name: M:Tracto.Desktop.Input.Tests.ClipboardTests.PasteAsync_BestEffortRestore_SnapshotCapturedAndRestoredAfterPaste
member.summary: With BestEffortRestore policy: 1. Snapshot is captured from the mock clipboard before the paste. 2. After paste the mock clipboard is restored to the snapshot value.

member.name: M:Tracto.Desktop.Input.Tests.ClipboardTests.PasteAsync_NoRestore_ClipboardNotRestored
member.summary: With NoRestore policy the clipboard is NOT restored: it holds the paste text.

member.name: M:Tracto.Desktop.Input.Tests.ClipboardTests.PasteAsync_RetryClassNever_SecondCallIsIndependentInvocation
member.summary: PasteAsync retry class is NEVER: a second call is a fully separate invocation. Calling PasteAsync twice should result in two independent executions, each throwing UnknownOutcomeException — no internal retry between them.

member.summary: When an exception is thrown after the clipboard is opened but before GetText, CloseClipboard must still be called (via finally). We simulate this by making GetText throw, then call ForceCloseHandle and verify the provider registered the close.
